data.titulo: Babg 4—Israɛll pipi rĩmã yãkr n tãag b sẽn yõg-b n kẽng yembd Babilonnã
data.contenido:
A Sayull n yɩ Israɛll pipi rĩma. La a Zeova wa n bas-⁠a lame n yãk a Davɩɩd t’a ledg-⁠a. D na n goma a Davɩɩd yell wʋsgo. A sẽn wa n yaa bi-​bɩɩga, a zaba ne nin-​wobg a Goliate. Kaoosg zugẽ, a wa n zoeeme, bala rĩm a Sayull da maanda sũ-kiir ne-⁠a. Pʋg-​sõng a Abigayill me kɩtame t’a pa maan wẽng ye.

Rẽ poore, d na n goma a Davɩɩd biig a Salomo yelle. A Davɩɩd kũumã poore, a Salomo n lebg Israɛll rĩma. A Sayull rɩɩ a naamã yʋʋm 40, a Davɩɩd ne a Salomo me yɩɩ woto. A Salomo kũumã poore, Israɛll soolmã welga zĩis a yiibu. A yembr bee rɩtg t’a ye be goabga.

Rɩtg soabã yaa buud piiga, tɩ goabg soabã yaa buud a yiibu. Rɩtg soabã kaoosa yʋʋm kobs-⁠yi la pis-⁠nu la a yopoe tɩ Asiri nebã yaool n wa sãam-⁠a. Yʋʋm koabg la pis-​tã la a tãab poore, b sãama goabg soabã me. Wakat kãnga, b talla Israɛll nebã n kẽng yembd Babilon. Dẽnd babg a naasã gomda yel-​kãsems sẽn zĩnd yʋʋm kobs-⁠nu la piig pʋgẽ yelle.

YÃMB nee a Sãmwɛll sẽn pʋdgd kaamã raoã zugã bɩ? Pĩnd wẽndẽ wã, yaa woto la b ra maand Israɛlle, n na n wilg tɩ b yãka ned t’a na n lebg rĩma. A Zeova yeela a Sãmwɛll t’a ning a Sayull zugã kaam. La pa kaam yaar ye. Sẽn paase, a yũuga ra yaa noogo.

A Sayull ra tagsdame tɩ yẽ pa tõe n yɩ rĩm ye. A yeela a Sãmwɛll yaa: ‘Mam yaa Bẽnzame buudã neda, la mam buudã yaa bilf n yɩɩd Israɛll buud a taabã. Yaa bõe tɩ fo yet tɩ maam n na n lebga rĩma?’ A Zeova ra nonga a Sayulli, bala a ra pa wuk-⁠m-​meng soab ye. Yaa rẽ yĩng la a Zeova sẽn yãk-⁠a t’a na n lebg rĩmã.

A Sayull ra pa nin-​bil ye. A ra yaa ra-​woko. A woglmã ra yɩɩda Israɛll nebã fãa. A ra pa naong soab ye. A zakã rãmb da yaa arzɛk rãmba. A Sayull da leb n yaa ned sẽn zoet tʋʋl-​tʋʋle, la ned sẽn tar pãng wʋsgo. A Zeova sẽn yãk-⁠a t’a na n yɩ rĩma yɩɩ Israɛll nebã noogo. Nebã fãa kelmame n yeel tɩ: ‘Wẽnd na kõ rĩmã yõore!’

Israɛll nebã bɛɛb ra ket n tara pãnga. B ra ket n namsda Israɛll nebã. A Sayull sẽn lebg rĩmã poor bilf bala, Amõ nebã yikame n na n zab ne-⁠ba. La a Sayull tigma sodaas wʋsg tɩ b tɩ zab ne Amõ nebã n tõoge. Nebã sũur da yaa noogo, b sẽn paam t’a Sayull yaa b naabã yĩnga.

A Sayull lʋɩɩ taoor tɩ Israɛll nebã tõog zab wʋsgo. A Sayull da tara bi-​ribl yʋʋr sẽn yaa a Zonatã. A Zonatã ra yaa gãndaoogo. A sõnga Israɛll nebã tɩ b tõog zab wʋsgo. Filisti nebã ra ket n yaa Israɛll nebã bɛɛb meng-​menga. Raar a yembre, Filisti neb wʋsg n wa n na n zab ne Israɛll nebã.

A Sãmwɛll yeela a Sayull t’a yaas t’a wa maan maoong n kõ a Zeova tɩ b yaool n kẽng zabrã. La a Sãmwɛll ra kaoosdame n pa watẽ ye. A Sayull me ra zoetame tɩ Filisti nebã na n wa sɩng zabrã tɩ bãmb nan pa yõog maandã n kõ a Zeova ye. Rẽ n so t’a yõog maandã a toore. A Sãmwɛll sẽn wa n ta wã, a yeela a Sayull t’a kɩɩsame, la t’a Zeova na n yãka ned a to t’a lebg Israɛll rĩma.

Raar a to yɛsa, a Sayull kɩɩsame. A Sãmwɛll yeel-⁠a lame yaa: ‘Fo sã n sak a Zeova n são fo sẽn na n dɩk piis sẽn nob n maan maand n kõ-a. Fo sẽn pa kelg a Zeova wã, yẽ me yeelame tɩ f ka na n le yɩ rĩm ye.’

Kiba-​kãngã zãmsda tõnd tɩ d segd n saka a Zeova noorã wakat fãa. Sẽn leb n paase, woto wilgdame tɩ wa sẽn yɩ to-⁠to ne a Sayullã, ned tõe n yaa nin-​sõngo, n wa yik n lebg nin-​wẽnga. D modg n da wa yɩ nin-​wẽng ye.1 Sãmwɛll sak a 9 n tɩ tãag 11; 13:​5-⁠14; 14:⁠47-⁠52; 15:​1-⁠35; 2 Sãmwɛll 1:⁠23. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YÃMB nee we-​rũngã sẽn gãe fotã zugã bɩ? Yaa urs. A ra yõka pe-​bil n na n tɩ wãb tɩ bi-​riblã pʋgl-⁠a n tak pe-​bilã n fãage. La ursã baoome n na n yõk bi-​riblã, tɩ bi-​riblã kʋ-⁠a. Raar a to me, bi-​riblã fãaga pesg tɩ bõn-​yẽeg ka paam-⁠a n wãb ye. Ad bi-​ribl kãngã sɩd pa yɛɛsd baa fʋɩ koe! Yãmb mi-⁠a lame bɩ?

Yaa a Davɩɩde. A yita Betlehɛm. A yaab-​raoogã yʋʋr da yaa a Obɛd. A Obɛd ra yaa a Rut ne a Boaaz biiga. Yãmb ket n tẽrame bɩ? A Davɩɩd ba la a Izayi bɩ a Zese. A Davɩɩd ra gũuda a ba wã piisi. Yaa a Zeova sẽn yãk a Sayull t’a lebg rĩmã yʋʋm 10 poor la a Davɩɩd rog-​yã.

A Zeova wa n yeela a Sãmwɛll raar a ye yaa: ‘Rɩk kaam ning b sẽn tar n zaeed rĩm dãmbã n kẽng a Zese nengẽ Betlehɛm. Mam yãka a bi-​ribl a ye t’a na n lebg rĩma.’ A Sãmwɛll sẽn ta n yã a Zese bi-​kãseng a Eliaabã, a yeela a sũurẽ tɩ ‘segd n yaa yãoã la a Zeova sẽn yãkã.’ La a Zeova yeel-⁠a lame yaa: ‘Ra ges a rasãndã ne a woglmã ye. Bala, ka yẽ la mam yãk t’a yɩ rĩm ye.’

A Zese boola a bi-​ribl a Abinadaabe, la a Sãmwɛll yeelame tɩ pa yẽ me ye. T’a Zese bool a Sama, la pa yɩ yẽ me ye. A Zese boola a kom-​dibli a yopoe tɩ b wa a Sãmwɛll taoore, la a Zeova pa yãk b baa a yen ye. A Sãmwɛll soka a Zese yaa: ‘Yaa fo kom-​dibli wã fãa la woto bɩ?’

T’a Zese leok yaa: ‘B yao-​zʋʋgã n kete, la a gũuda piisi.’ B sẽn bool a Davɩɩd t’a wa ta a Sãmwɛll taoorã, a Sãmwɛll yãame t’a yaa rasãnga. A Zeova yeela a Sãmwɛll yaa: ‘Yaa yẽ la mam yãk-​yã. Ning a zugã kaamã.’ A Sãmwɛll sɩd zaea a Davɩɩd zugã kaamã. Wakat n na n wa zĩnd t’a Davɩɩd lebg Israɛll rĩma.1 Sãmwɛll 17:⁠34, 35; 16:​1-⁠13. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

FILISTI nebã le waame n na n zab ne Israɛll nebã. A Davɩɩd kẽem dãmb a tãab n lebg a Sayull sodaase. Daar a yembre, a Zese yeela a Davɩɩd t’a tall ka-​sãrdɩ la bur n tɩ kõ a kẽem dãmbã la a bãng b keelem.

A Davɩɩd sẽn ta zabrã zĩigẽ wã, a kẽnga a kẽem dãmbã sẽn beẽ wã. Filisti nin-​wobg a Goliat kolgame n na n yaal Israɛll nebã. Yaa rasem 40 masã la a sẽn maand woto wã. A ra maanda rẽ yibeoog fãa la zaabr fãa. A zẽka a koɛɛg n yeel Israɛll nebã yaa: ‘Bɩ y yãk y ned a ye t’a wa tɩ maam ne yẽ zab ne taaba. Yẽ sã n tõog maam n kʋ, tõnd na n yɩɩ yãmb yembse, la mam sã n tõog yẽ n kʋ, yãmb na n yɩɩ tõnd yembse. Yãmb sã n yaa rapa, bɩ y yãk ned t’a wa tɩ d zabe.’ A Davɩɩd soka sodaasã yaa: ‘Ned sã n kʋ Filisti nedã n yiis Israɛll nebã yãnde, bõe la b na n kõ a soaba?’

Tɩ sodaag a ye leok-⁠a yaa: ‘Rĩma na n kõo a soab arzɛk wʋsgo, la a rɩk a bi-​pugl n kõ-a t’a maan a paga.’

La Israɛll nebã fãa ra zoeta a Goliate, bala a ra yaa nin-​wobgo. A woglmã ra kolga metr a 3, tɩ sodaag me ra be taoor n zãad a gãongã.

Israɛll sodaas n kẽng n tɩ yeel rĩm a Sayull t’a Davɩɩd rat n tɩ zaba ne a Goliate. La a Sayull yeela a Davɩɩd yaa: ‘Fo ka tõe n kẽng n tɩ zab ne Filisti nin-​kãngã ye. Bala fo yaa biiga, la yẽ yaa sodaag hal a yãadmẽ.’ A Davɩɩd leokame yaa: ‘Mam sẽn da wa n gũud m ba wã piisã, bõn-​yẽeg ne urs n yõk piis tɩ mam dig-⁠b n tɩ kʋ. Mam na n kʋʋ Filisti nin-​kãngã me woto. A Zeova na n sõnga maam.’ T’a Sayull yeel-⁠a yaa: ‘Bɩ f kẽng t’a Zeova bee ne foom.’

A Davɩɩd kẽnga kʋɩlg noor n tɩ rɩgs kug-​saals a nu n sui a korgẽ wã. La yẽ zãa a loaabg n na n tɩ zab ne Filisti nedã. A Goliat sẽn yã a Davɩɩdã, a tagsame t’a na n tõog-⁠a-⁠la faag-​faaga.

A yeela a Davɩɩd yaa: ‘Bɩ f wa tɩ m na n kʋ-⁠f lame n kõ yɩbred ne we-​rũms tɩ b wãbe.’ La a Davɩɩd leokame yaa: ‘Fo zãada sʋʋg ne kãnd la munmun n wat mam nengẽ. La mam wata fo nengẽ ne a Zeova yʋʋre. Rũndã, a Zeova na n kɩtame tɩ m tõog n kʋ foo.’

A Davɩɩd wudgame n kolgd a Goliate, n tʋm a nug a korgã pʋgẽ n yãk kugr a ye n ning a loaabgã pʋgẽ, n wɩsg a meng n lobg-⁠a, tɩ kugrã tɩ wẽ a Goliat rĩirã n sud n kẽ pʋgẽ t’a lʋɩ tẽng n ki. Filisti nebã sẽn yã tɩ b gãndaoogã lʋɩɩme wã, b lebgame n sɩng zoeese. Israɛll nebã rig-⁠b lame n tõog zabrã.1 Sãmwɛll 17:​1-⁠54. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

A DAVƖƖD sẽn kʋ a Goliatã poore, Israɛll sodaasã naab a Abneer tall-⁠a lame n kẽng a Sayull nengẽ. A Sayull sũur yɩɩ noog ne a Davɩɩd wʋsgo. A kɩtame tɩ yẽ me paam naam a sodaasã sʋka, la a kɩt t’a wa zĩnd na-​zakẽ wã.

Israɛll sodaasã wa n yii raar a ye n tɩ zab ne Filisti nebã n tõog-⁠ba. B sẽn wa n lebgdẽ wã, pagbã ra yɩɩndame n yetẽ yaa: ‘A Sayull kʋʋ neb tusri, t’a Davɩɩd kʋ neb tus piiga.’ Gom-​kãensã kɩtame tɩ sũ-kiir yõk a Sayulli, bala pagbã ra waoogda a Davɩɩd n yɩɩd yẽ. La a Sayull biig a Zonatã ra pa maand sũ-kiir ye. A ra nonga a Davɩɩd wʋsgo, t’a Davɩɩd me nong-⁠a. B yiibã pʋlma taab tɩ b na n kell n yɩɩ zo-​rãmb wakat fãa. A Davɩɩd ra mii pɛndg wẽeb hal tɩ noom a Sayulli. La raar a yembre, sũ-kiirã yĩng kɩtame t’a Sayull maan bũmb sẽn pa sõma. A Davɩɩd sẽn wa n zĩ n wẽed pɛndgã, a Sayull rɩka a kãndã n tão n yeel yaa: ‘M na n kaa a Davɩɩd ne lalgã.’ La a Davɩɩd kuugame tɩ kãndã ka paam-⁠a ye. Raar a to me, a Sayull le tãoa a Davɩɩd ne kãndã n yõsge. Rẽ tɛkã, a Davɩɩd bãngame t’a segd n gũusa a meng wʋsg ne a Sayulli.

Yãmb ket n tẽra a Sayull sẽn da pʋlem bũmb ningã bɩ? A ra pʋlmame t’a na n dɩka a bi-​pugl n kõ ned ning sẽn na n tõog n kʋ a Goliatã. A Sayull pa kõ a Davɩɩd a pagã tao-​tao ye. La a wa n yeela a Davɩɩd t’a sã n dat yẽ bi-​pugl a Mikalle, a segd n deng n kʋʋ Filisti neb koabga. Yãmb we n ges koe! A Sayull ra tẽedame tɩ Filisti nebã na n kʋʋ a Davɩɩde, la pa yɩ woto ye. Masa wã a kong n dɩka a Mikall n kõ a Davɩɩd t’a maan a paga.

Raar a yembre, a Sayull yeela a Zonatã la a sõgen dãmbã fãa t’a rat n kʋʋ a Davɩɩde. La a Zonatã yeela a ba wã yaa: ‘Ra maan a Davɩɩd wẽng ye. Bala a zɩ n maan foo wẽng ye. Yẽ maana foo neer wʋsgo. A gẽnega a yõor n kʋ a Goliate, la fo meng sũur yɩɩ noogo.’

A Sayull kelga a biigã goamã, n yeel t’a pa na n kʋ a Davɩɩd ye. A Davɩɩd lebg n waa a Sayull zakẽ wã n le tʋmd be wa pĩndã. La daar a yembre, a Davɩɩd ra wẽeda pɛndgã yɛsa, t’a Sayull le rɩk a kãndã n na n tão-⁠a. A Davɩɩd kuugame tɩ kãndã tɩ sel lalgã. Yaa naoor a tãab la woto a Sayull sẽn mak n na n kʋ-⁠a. A Davɩɩd bãngame tɩ masã wã, rẽnda a zoe.

Baraar yʋngã, a Davɩɩd zoee n kẽnga yẽ mengã zakẽ wã. La a Sayull tʋma neb tɩ b tɩ kʋ-⁠a. A Mikall bãnga tiir n yeel a sɩdã yaa: ‘Fo sã n ka zoe yʋngã, b na n kʋʋ foo beoogo.’ A Mikall sõnga a Davɩɩd t’a tũ fenetr n yi n zoe. Sẽn na maan yʋʋm a yopoe, a Davɩɩd ra zoet n soondame sẽn na yɩl t’a Sayull ra paam-⁠a n kʋ ye.1 Sãmwɛll 17:⁠55-⁠58; 18:​1-⁠30; 19:​1-⁠18. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YÃMB mii pʋg-​neer ning sẽn kẽnd n segd a Davɩɩdã bɩ? A yʋʋr la a Abigayille. A ra tara yam, la a kɩtame t’a Davɩɩd pa maan wẽng ye. La nand tɩ d gom rẽ yelle, d reng n ges bũmb ning sẽn paam a Davɩɩde.

A Davɩɩd sẽn wa n zoe n yi a Sayull zakẽ wã, a tɩ solga tãng bokẽ. A kẽem dãmbã la a zakã rãmb fãa tɩ bʋʋg-⁠a-⁠la beenẽ. Yaa sẽn na ta neb kobs-​naas n tɩ bʋʋg a Davɩɩde, t’a Davɩɩd lebg b taoor soaba. A Davɩɩd kẽnga Moaab rĩmã nengẽ n tɩ yeel-⁠a yaa: ‘Mam dat n bõosa foo tɩ m ba wã ne m ma wã zĩnd ne foo, hal tɩ m wa bãng bũmb ning sẽn na n paam-⁠ma.’ Rẽ poore, a Davɩɩd ne rap nins sẽn da tũud-⁠a wã ra zoet n soonda tãensã bogdẽ.

Yaa a Davɩɩd sẽn wa n yi tãensẽ wã poor la a seg a Abigayille. A Abigayill sɩd a Naball ra yaa rakãagr sẽn tar pʋt wʋsgo. A ra tara piis tus a tã la bʋʋs tusri. A Naball ra yaa nin-​wẽnga, la a pag a Abigayill ra yaa pʋg-​neer la pag sẽn tar yam. Raar a yembr menga, a fãaga a zaka rãmba. Bɩ d ges sẽn yɩ to-⁠to.

A Davɩɩd ne a nebã ra maana a Naball neere. B sõngame n ges a piisã yell tɩ wagda pa zu-⁠b ye. Daar a yembre, a Davɩɩd tʋma a nebã tɩ b tɩ kos a Naball bũmbu. A Davɩɩd nebã tɩ mikame t’a Naball ne a tʋm-​tʋmdbã da wõrsd piisã kõbdo. A Naball ra tara rɩ-​nood wʋsg baraarã, bala ra yaa kibs daare. A Davɩɩd nebã yeela a Naball yaa: ‘Tõnd maana foo neere. Tõnd pa zuk f pesg baa a yen ye, la d sõngame n ges b yelle. D bõos tɩ f bao rɩɩb n kõ-do.’

A Naball yeelame yaa: ‘Mam ka na n dɩk m dɩɩb n kõ nin-​yaals wa yãmb ye.’ A Naball goma a Davɩɩd nebã gom-​põaasa, n tʋ a Davɩɩde. Rapã sẽn lebg n tɩ togs a Davɩɩdã, a Davɩɩd sũurã puugame t’a yeel a nebã tɩ b bob sʋʋs tɩ b tɩ kʋ a Naball ne a nebã.

A Naball tʋm-​tʋmd a ye n wʋm a Naball sẽn da gomd a Davɩɩd nebã to-⁠to wã, n tɩ togs a Abigayille. Tao-​tao bala, a Abigayill baoa rɩɩb n zɩlg bõens n dɩk sorã n debd a Davɩɩd nengẽ. A sẽn wa n seg a Davɩɩd sorã zugã, a siga a bõangã zug n yĩgimd a Davɩɩd taoor n yeel yaa: ‘Maan-⁠y sugr la y ra ges mam sɩd a Naball sẽn maan bũmb ningã ye. A yaa yalma, la a tʋmda yalem-​tʋʋma. Maan-⁠y sugr la y reeg bũmb nins mam sẽn zã n na n wa kõ yãmbã, la y kõ tõnd sugr d kongrã yĩnga.’

A Davɩɩd yeela a Abigayill yaa: ‘Fo yaa pag sẽn tar yam. Fo gɩdga maam tɩ m pa kʋ a Naball a wẽnemã yĩng ye. Wẽnd na kuls-⁠f laafɩ.’ A Naball wa n kiime, t’a Davɩɩd rɩk a Abigayill n maan a paga.1 Sãmwɛll 22:​1-⁠4; 25:​1-⁠43. Study Questions

A SAYULL le makame n na n yõk a Davɩɩde. A yãka sodaas tus a tãab sẽn mi zabr sõma tɩ b na n yãag-⁠a tɩ b tɩ bao a Davɩɩde. A Davɩɩd sẽn wʋm rẽ wã, a kɩtame tɩ neb na n tɩ gũus n ges a Sayull ne a sodaasã sẽn na n gãand zĩig ning yʋn-​kãngã. Rẽ poore, a soka a neb a yiib woto: ‘Ãnda n na n tũ maam n kẽng a Sayull sika zĩigẽ?’

A Abisayi leokame tɩ yẽ n na n tũ. A Abisayi yaa a Davɩɩd kẽem a Zeruiya biiga. A Davɩɩd ne a Abisayi ta n mikame t’a Sayull ne a sodaasã ra gõeeme. B soosame n kẽ sikã zĩigẽ n dɩk a Sayull kãndã ne a lɩngã sẽn da rɩg a zugẽ wã. B fãa sẽn da gõe sõma wã yĩnga, ned baa a ye ka bãng ye.

Ges-⁠y a Davɩɩd ne a Abisayi sẽn be zĩig ning masã. B lebg n yii sikã zĩigẽ tɩ bũmb ka paam-⁠b ye. Masã, b bee tãngã zugu. A Davɩɩd zẽka a koɛɛg n yeel Israɛll sodaasã naab yaa: ‘Abneer, bõe yĩng tɩ fo pa gũ rĩmã sẽn yaa f zu-​soabã? A kãndã ne a lɩngã bee yɛ?’

A Sayull nekame, n bãng a Davɩɩd koɛɛgã n sok-⁠a yaa: ‘Yaa m biig a Davɩɩd bɩ?’ Foto ning sẽn be rɩtgã pʋgẽ, yãmb pa ne a Sayull ne a Abneer sɩda?

A Davɩɩd yeela a Sayull yaa: ‘N-⁠ye, m zu-​soab la m dĩma, yaa maam. Yaa bõe tɩ y rigd maam? Mam maana yãmb bõe? Naaba, ad y kãndã, tʋm-⁠y ned a ye t’a wa reege.’ A Sayull yeelame yaa: ‘Mam kongame. Mam maana yalemdo.’ Rẽ poore, a Davɩɩd rɩka a sor t’a Sayull me lebg n kuli. La a Davɩɩd tagsame t’a sã n pa zoe n kẽng Filisti rãmbã tẽngẽ, a Sayull na n wa kʋ-⁠a-⁠la raar a yembre. A sɩd kẽnga Filisti rãmbã nengẽ, n belg Filisti nebã tɩ b tẽ t’a lebga b zoa.

Kaoosg zugẽ Filisti nebã wa n zaba ne Israɛll nebã. A Sayull ne a Zonatã kii zabrã pʋgẽ, t’a Davɩɩd sũurã sãam wʋsgo. A gʋlsa yɩɩll b yĩnga, la yɩɩlã pʋgẽ a yeelame yaa: ‘M saam-​biig a Zonatã, mam sũurã sãamame. Mam da nonga foo wʋsgo.’

Rẽ poore, a Davɩɩd leba Israɛll n tɩ zĩnd Hebrõ. Zabr n zĩnd neb nins sẽn da rat t’a Sayull biig a Isbosɛt reeg naamã ne neb nins sẽn da rat tɩ yɩ a Davɩɩdã sʋka. La yaa a Davɩɩd n lebg rĩmã. A sẽn wa n deegd naamã t’a tara yʋʋm 30. A rɩɩ naam Hebrõ yʋʋm a yopoe la pʋɩ-​sʋka. A roga kom-​dibli kẽer Hebrõ. Bãmb kẽer yʋy la woto: A Amnõ, a Absalom la a Adoniza.

A Davɩɩd ne a sodaasã yika raar a ye n na n tɩ zab n deeg Zerizalɛm. Ra yaa tẽn-​neere. Yaa a Davɩɩd kẽem a Zeruiya bi-​ribl a Zoaab n lʋɩ zabrã taoore. Rẽ poore, a Davɩɩd kɩtame t’a Zoaab lebg a sodaasã naaba. A Davɩɩd sɩnga naam dɩɩb Zerizalɛm masã.1 Sãmwɛll 26:​1-⁠25; 27:​1-⁠7; 31:​1-⁠6; 2 Sãmwɛll 1:⁠26; 3:​1-⁠21; 5:​1-⁠10; 1 Kibaya 11:​1-⁠9. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

A DAVƖƖD sẽn sɩng a naamã rɩɩb Zerizalɛmmã tɛka, a Zeova kɩtame t’a sodaasã tõog bɛɛb wʋsgo. A Zeova ra pʋlmame t’a na n kõo Israɛll nebã Kanaã tẽngã tɩ b sooge. A Zeova sɩd sõng-⁠b lame tɩ b reeg tẽngã gill masã.

A Davɩɩd ra yaa na-​sõngo. A ra nonga a Zeova. Rẽ n so t’a sẽn deeg Zerizalɛm tẽngã n soogã poor bala, a kɩtame tɩ b tall a Zeova kãabg koglgã n wa Zerizalɛm. A da ratame n me wẽnd-​doog n ning koglgã be.

La kaoosg zugẽ, a Davɩɩd maana bũmb sẽn pa sõma. A Davɩɩd ra miime tɩ pa sõma tɩ f rɩk f sẽn pa so ye. La zaabr a yembre, a rʋʋ a roogã zug n na n kok pemsem, la a zĩnda be n yã pʋg-​neere. Pagã yʋʋr la a Batseba, t’a sɩdã yʋʋr yaa a Uri. A Uri yaa a Davɩɩd sodaaga.

A Davɩɩd yamã kẽe a Batseba wʋsgo, t’a kɩt tɩ b tɩ tall-⁠a n wa. A Batseba sɩdã ra kẽnga zabre. A Davɩɩd gãanda a Batseba, t’a rɩk pʋga. Yellã paka a Davɩɩd masã. A gʋlsa sebr n tool sodaasã naab a Zoaab n yeel t’a ning a Uri zabrã zĩig ning a sẽn mi t’a pa na n põsã. A Uri kũumã poore, a Davɩɩd rɩka a Batseba n maan a paga.

A Zeova sũurã puuga wʋsg ne a Davɩɩde, t’a tʋm a Natã t’a tɩ togs-⁠a t’a sẽn maanã yaa yel-​wẽnde. Yãmb pa ne a Natã sẽn yas n gomd ne a Davɩɩd sɩda? A Davɩɩd sũurã sãama wʋsg ne yell ning a sẽn maanã. Rẽ n so t’a Zeova pa kʋ-⁠a ye. La a Zeova yeel-⁠a lame yaa: ‘Fo sẽn maan yel-​kãensã wã yĩnga, zu-​loees wʋsg n na n kẽ fo zakã.’ Sɩd yɩɩ woto.

Pipi, a Batseba sẽn dog biig ningã kiime. Sẽn pʋgde, a Davɩɩd bi-​kãseng a Amnõ modga a yao a Tamaar n gãand-⁠a. A Davɩɩd biig a Absalom sũurã puuga ne rẽ t’a kʋ a Amnõ. Rẽ poore, a Absalom maana a sẽn na n maaneg tɩ nebã nong-⁠a, t’a yik n yeel tɩ yaa yẽ la rĩm masã. La a Davɩɩd wa n kong n zaba ne a Absalom, t’a Absalom ki zabrã pʋgẽ. Vẽenega, a Davɩɩd zu-​loeesã yɩɩ wʋsgo.

La a Batseba wa n doga bi-​ribl tɩ b pʋd a yʋʋr t’a Salomo. A Davɩɩd sẽn wa n kʋʋl n bẽedẽ wã, a biig a Adoniza yikame n dat n deeg naamã. La a Davɩɩd kɩtame tɩ maan-​kʋʋd a Zadok ning a Salomo zugã kaam n wilg tɩ yaa yẽ la b kõ naamã. Rẽ poor bilfu, a Davɩɩd kiime. A sẽn wa n kiidẽ wã t’a tara yʋʋm 70. A rɩɩ naamã yʋʋm 40. La masã yaa a Salomo n lebg Israɛll rĩmã.2 Sãmwɛll 11:​1-⁠27; 12:​1-⁠18; 1 Rĩm dãmba 1:​1-⁠48. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

A SALOMO sẽn wa n deegd naamã t’a yaa bi-​bɩɩga. A ra nonga a Zeova. A sak n tũu a ba a Davɩɩd sẽn sagl-⁠a bũmb ningã. A Zeova ra nonga a Salomo hal n vẽneg a meng zãmsd pʋgẽ n yeel-⁠a yaa: ‘Wilg maam fo sẽn dat bũmb ning tɩ m kõ-fo.’

A Salomo yeela a Zeova yaa: ‘Zeova, mam nan yaa biiga, m ka mi m sẽn segd n dɩ naamã to-⁠to ye. Bɩ f kõ maam yam tɩ m tõog n zã f nebã sõma.’

A Salomo sẽn kos bũmb ningã yɩɩ a Zeova noog t’a yeel-⁠a yaa: ‘Fo ka kos yõ-wok bɩ arzegs ye. Fo kosa yam. Woto yĩnga, mam na n kõo foo yam. Neb nins sẽn deng foomã ka tol n paam yam a woto ye. La neb nins sẽn na n pʋgl foomã me ka na n tol n paam yam a woto ye. Mam na n kõo foom bũmb nins fo sẽn ka kosã me. Mam na n kõo foom arzegs ne naam.’

Rẽ poor bilfu, pagb a yiib n wa n yã a Salomo n yeel-⁠a t’a welg b yel-​kãseng n kõ-ba. A yembr yeelame yaa: ‘Maam ne pʋg-​kãngã bee roog a ye pʋgẽ ne taaba. Mam doga m bi-​ribla. Mam sẽn dog tɩ rab-​tãtẽ, la yẽ me rog a bi-​riblã. La pʋg-​kãngã biigã kii yʋngẽ. La a yika yʋn-​sʋka, n dɩk biig ning sẽn ki wã n gãneg mam taoor la a rɩk mam biigã. Beoogã sẽn vẽege, mam yikame n mik tɩ biig ning sẽn be mam taoorã ka mam biigã ye.’

La pag a to wã yeelame yaa: ‘Ka woto ye, biig ning sẽn ket n vɩ wã la mam biigã la biig ning sẽn ki wã yaa fo rẽnda.’ La pipi soabã yeelame yaa: ‘Ayo, biig ning sẽn ki wã yaa fo biiga, tɩ sẽn vɩ-⁠a wã yaa mam biiga.’ B ra yas n wẽeda no-​koeemd ne taaba. La bõe la a Salomo maan-​yã?

A yeelame tɩ b wa ne sʋʋga. B sẽn wa ne sʋʋgã a yeelame yaa: ‘Pasg-⁠y biig ning sẽn vɩ wã a yiib n kõ pag a ye pʋɩ-​sʋk la b kõ a to wã me pʋɩ-​sʋka.’ La biigã ma meng-​mengã kelmame n yeel yaa: ‘Maan-⁠y sugr la y kõ-a biigã la y ra kʋ-⁠a ye.’ La pag a to wã yeelame yaa: ‘Bɩ b pasg-⁠a tɩ tõnd d yiibã fãa konge.’

Rẽ poore a Salomo yeelame yaa: ‘Ra kʋ-⁠y biigã ye. Rɩk-⁠y-​yã n kõ pipi pagã tɩ yaa yẽ la biigã ma.’ A Salomo bãngame tɩ pipi pagã la biigã ma, bala pʋg-​kãng ra nonga biigã wʋsgo, hal n sak n yet tɩ b rɩk biigã n kõ pag a to wã la b ra kʋ-⁠a ye. Nebã sẽn wʋm a Salomo sẽn welg yellã to-⁠to wã, b sũurã yɩɩ noogo, bala b ra tara rĩm sẽn yaa yam soaba.

A Salomo naamã sasa, Wẽnnaam ninga Israɛll nebã barka. A kɩtame tɩ ki, kankam ne viyn tɩɩs la rɩɩb a taab zĩnd wʋsgo. Nebã ra yera fu-​neeb la b vɩ ro-​neeb pʋsẽ. Nebã fãa vɩɩm ra yaa noogo.1 Rĩm dãmba 3:​3-⁠28; 5:​5-​14. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

NAND t’a Davɩɩd ki, a kõo a Salomo a Zeova roogã pãlã. Yaa a Zeova meng n da wilg a Davɩɩd a sẽn dat tɩ b me a roogã to-⁠to. A Salomo sẽn deeg naamã yʋʋm a naas-⁠n-​soabã pʋgẽ, a sɩnga wẽnd-​doogã meebo. Meebã rɩka yʋʋm a yopoe la pʋɩ-​sʋka. Yaa sẽn yɩɩd neb tus koabg la tus pis-​nii n me wẽnd-​doogã. Meebã rɩɩ ligd wʋsg me, bala sãnem la wanzuri wʋsg la b tall n me.

Wẽnd-​doogã ra tara ro-​pʋs wʋsgo, la a yiib n da yaa wala sɛk-​roogã ro-​pʋs a yiibã. La b bedrem ra taa sɛk-​roogã rẽnd naoor a yiibu. A Salomo kɩtame tɩ b ning kãabg koglgã wẽnd-​doogã pʋgẽ ro-​taoorã pʋgẽ, la b ning sɛk-​roogã teed a taabã ro-​pʋg a yembrẽ wã.

Wẽnd-​doogã sẽn wa n me n sa wã, b maana kibs kãsenga. Wa yãmb sẽn ne foto wã zugã, kibsã sasa, a Salomo yĩgimdame n tees wẽnd-​doogã n pʋʋs a Zeova n yeel yaa: ‘Gese, maam miime tɩ saasã sẽn ka tõe n sek foomã, yaa vẽeneg tɩ ro-​kãngã mam sẽn me wã me ka tõe n sek foo ye. La baasgo, m kot-⁠f lame tɩ f kelg neb nins sẽn na n tees zĩ-kãngã n pʋʋsã.’

A Salomo sẽn pʋʋs n sa wã, bugum n yi yĩngr n yõog rũms nins b sẽn da kʋ n na n maan maandã. A Zeova kɩtame tɩ vẽenem yãg wẽnd-​doogã pʋgẽ. Woto wilgame t’a Zeova reega a Salomo pʋʋsgã, la t’a sũurã nooma ne wẽnd-​doogã. Masã, nebã rebda wẽnd-​doogẽ wã n pʋʋsd a Zeova, pa le yaa sɛk-​roogẽ wã ye. A Salomo rɩɩ a naamã ne yam yʋʋm wʋsgo, tɩ nebã me sũy ra noomẽ. La a Salomo kẽe kãadem ne pagb wʋsg sẽn da pa Israɛll neb la sẽn da pa tũud a Zeova ye. Yãmb pa ne a pag a ye sẽn be fotã zug n pʋʋsd bõn-​naandg sɩda? A Salomo pagbã wa n kɩtame tɩ yẽ me pʋʋsd wẽnnaam dãmb a taaba. Yãmb mii rẽ sẽn kɩt t’a maan bũmb ning bɩ? A ra pa le get nebã yell sõma ye. A lebga nin-​toaaga, la nebã sũy ra pa le noom ne-⁠a ye.

A Zeova sũurã puugame t’a yeel a Salomo yaa: ‘Mam na n deega fo rĩungã n kõ ned a to. La ka na n yɩ fo nifẽ ye. Na n yɩɩ f biigã naamẽ. La baasgo, mam ka na n deeg soolmã zãng n bas-⁠a ye.’ Bɩ d ges rẽnda sẽn yɩ to-⁠to.1 Kibaya 28:​9-⁠21; 29:​1-⁠9; 1 Rĩm dãmba 5:⁠15-​321-⁠18, NW; 2 Kibaya 6:⁠12-⁠42; 7:​1-⁠5; 1 Rĩm dãmba 11:​9-⁠13. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YÃMB mii bũmb ning sẽn kɩt tɩ ra-​kãngã pãrsd a fuugã bɩ? Yaa a Zeova n yeel-⁠a t’a maan woto. Ra-​kãngã yaa Wẽnnaam no-​rɛɛs a Ahiza. Wẽnnaam no-​rɛɛs yaa bõe? Yaa ned Wẽnnaam sẽn yãk n kɩtdẽ t’a rengd n togsd nebã yɛl sẽn wate.

A Ahiza yas n gomda ne a Zeroboam. A Salomo ra yãka a Zeroboam t’a get meebã tʋʋm kẽer yelle. A Ahiza sẽn seg a Zeroboam sorã zugã, a maana bũmb sẽn ling a Zeroboam. A yeega fu-​paal ning a sẽn da yelgã n pãrs zĩis 12. Rẽ poore a yeela a Zeroboam t’a reeg bãmb 10 n sooge. Yãmb mii bũmb ning sẽn kɩt t’a Ahiza kõ a Zeroboam fuugã peen-​gɩrs 10 bɩ?

A Ahiza wilgame t’a Zeova na n deega a Salomo soolmã n bas-⁠a. A yeelame t’a Zeova na n kõo a Zeroboam Israɛll buud piig t’a sooge. Rat n yeelame tɩ yaa buud a yiib bal la a Salomo biig a Roboam na n sooge.

A Salomo sẽn wʋm a Ahiza sẽn yeel a Zeroboam goam ninsã, a sũurã puugame t’a baood n na n kʋ a Zeroboam. La a Zeroboam zoeeme n kẽng Ezipti. Rẽ poor bilfu, a Salomo kiime. A rɩɩ naamã yʋʋm 40. A biig a Roboam n dɩt naam masã. A Zeroboam sẽn zĩnd Ezipt n wʋm t’a Salomo kiime wã, a lebg n waa Israɛlle.

A Roboam pa rĩm-sõng ye. A namsda nebã n yɩɩd a ba a Salomo meng sẽn nams-⁠b to-⁠to wã. A Zeroboam ne tẽngã nin-​kãsems a taab kẽnga rĩm a Roboam nengẽ n na n tɩ bõos-⁠a t’a bas nebã namsgo. La a Roboam pa kelg ye. A namsa nebã n paas menga. Rẽ n so tɩ nebã kɩt t’a Zeroboam na n dɩ naam buud 10 zugu, la Bẽnzame ne Zida buudã yẽ kell n zĩnda a Roboam poorẽ.

A Zeroboam ra pa rat t’a nin-​buiidã kẽng Zerizalɛm n tɩ pʋʋs a Zeova wẽnd-​doogẽ wã ye. A maana sãnem nag-⁠bi a yiib n kɩt tɩ buud piigã neb pʋʋsd-⁠ba. Tao-​tao bala, tẽngã pida ne nin-​kʋʋr la tʋʋm-​beed a taaba.

Zu-​loees wʋsg n paam buud a yiibã nebã. A Roboam sẽn deeg naamã tɩ yʋʋm a nu, Ezipt naabã wa n zaba ne Zerizalɛm. A wʋka a Zeova roogã arzɛk wʋsg n looge. Dẽnd b sẽn da nags wẽnd-​doogã t’a yaa sõma to-⁠to wã pa yã n kaoos meng ye.1 Rĩm dãmba 11:⁠26-⁠43; 12:​1-⁠33; 14:⁠21-⁠31. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

RĨM a Zeroboam kũumã poore, rĩm dãmb nins fãa sẽn dɩ naam buud 10 zugã yɩɩ rĩm-yoodo. Rĩm a Akaab wẽnemã n da yɩɩd b fãa. Yãmb mii sẽn yaa bũmb ning yĩng bɩ? Yaa a pag a Zezabɛll sẽn da yaa nin-​wẽng wʋsgã yĩnga.

A Zezabɛll ra pa Israɛll ned ye. Ra yaa Sɩdõ rĩmã bi-​pugla. A ra pʋʋsda ziri wẽnnaam a Baalle, la a ra kɩtame t’a Akaab ne Israɛll neb wʋsg me ra pʋʋsd a Baalle. A Zezabɛll ra kisa a Zeova. A kɩtame tɩ b kʋ a Zeova no-​rɛɛsdb wʋsgo. Kẽer kong n zoe n tɩ solga tãens bogdẽ t’a pa paam n kʋ-⁠b ye. A Zezabɛll sã n da rat bũmbu, a saka a kʋ ned menga.

Daar a yembre, a Zezabɛll yãame tɩ rĩm a Akaab sũurã pa noome, t’a soka yaa: ‘Yaa bõe n maan tɩ fo sũurã pa noom rũndã?’

A Akaab leokame yaa: ‘Mam yeela a Nabot t’a koos a pʋʋgã ne maam la a zãgsame.’

La a Zezabɛll yeela a sɩdã t’a ra sãam a sũur t’a na n deega pʋʋgã n kõ-a.

A Zezabɛll gʋlsa sebr n kɩt tɩ b tɩ kɩs a Nabot sẽn be tẽng ning pʋgẽ wã nanambsã. A yeela sebrã pʋgẽ tɩ b kɩt tɩ nin-​yood rõd a Nabot n yeel t’a tʋʋsa Wẽnnaam ne rĩmã, la b yiis-⁠a yɩng n lob-⁠a ne kug t’a ki.

A Zezabɛll sẽn wʋm a Nabot kũumã bala, a yeela a Akaab yaa: ‘Yik n tɩ reeg a Nabot pʋʋgã masã.’ A Zezabɛll sẽn kɩt tɩ b kʋ a Nabotã, a pa segd ne sɩbgr sɩda?

A Zeova tʋma a Zehu t’a tɩ sɩbg-⁠a. A Zezabɛll sẽn wʋm t’a Zehu watame wã, a manega a meng hal sõmã la a rẽes a ninã kɩrʋ. La a Zehu sẽn kẽ na-​zakẽ wã n yã a Zezabɛll sẽn yas fenetrẽ wã, a yeela rap nins sẽn da yas a sɛɛgẽ wã tɩ b tus a Zezabɛll n lubi. Yãmb pa ne rapã sẽn gãd-⁠a wã sɩda? B tus-⁠a lame t’a tũ fenetrẽ wã n lʋɩ tẽng n ki.1 Rĩm dãmba 16:⁠29-⁠33; 18:​1-⁠4; 21:​1-⁠16; 2 Rĩm dãmba 9:⁠30-⁠37. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YÃMB mii rap nins sẽn be foto wã zugã bɩ? Bõe la b maanda? B rebda zabre, la rap nins sẽn be taoorã yaa yɩɩn-​yɩɩndba. La bõe yĩng tɩ bãmb pa zãad sʋʋs la kãn n na n tɩ zabe? Bɩ d ges tɩ d na bãng a võore.

A Zozafat yaa Bẽnzame ne Zida buudã rĩma. Yẽ ne a Akaab la a Zezabɛll fãa vɩɩmda wakat yɛnga. La a Zozafat ra yaa rĩm-​sõngo. A ba a Aza me yɩɩ rĩm-​sõngo. Rẽ n kɩt tɩ Bẽnzame ne Zida buudã neb vɩɩmd ne sũ-noog yʋʋm wʋsgo.

La bũmb n wa n maan tɩ nebã yɛɛse. Neb n wa n yeel a Zozafat yaa: ‘Sodaas wʋsg n yi Moaab ne Amo la Seyiir tãngã n wat n na n zab ne yãmba.’ Israɛll nebã wʋsg tigma taab Zerizalɛm n na n bõos a Zeova t’a sõng-⁠ba. B kẽnga wẽnd-​doogẽ wã, t’a Zozafat lʋɩ taoor n pʋʋs a Zeova n yeel yaa: ‘Zeova, tõnd ka tar pãng sẽn na n tõog zãma kãseng kãngã sẽn wat n na n zab ne tõndã ye. Tõnd ka mi d sẽn na n maan bũmb ning ye, d teega foo.’

A Zeova kelga b pʋʋsgã, n kɩt tɩ no-​rɛɛs a ye yeel nebã yaa: ‘Ka yãmb n so zabra ye. Yaa Wẽnnaam n so. Ka yãmb n na n zab zab-​kãngã ye. Yaas-⁠y bal n ges a Zeova sẽn na n fãag yãmb to-⁠to.’

Vẽkembeoog yibeoogo, a Zozafat yeela nebã tɩ b tẽ a Zeova t’a na n sõng-⁠b lame. A yãka yɩɩn-​yɩɩndb tɩ b na n lʋɩ sodaasã taoor n yɩɩnd n pẽgd a Zeova. B sẽn wa n kolgd zabrã zĩigẽ wã, yãmb mii bũmb ning sẽn maan bɩ? A Zeova kɩtame tɩ b bɛɛbã wẽneg n kʋ taaba. Israɛll nebã sẽn ta wã, b mikame tɩ b bɛɛbã fãa kiime.

Ad a Zozafat sɩd bãnga yam la a sẽn teeg a Zeova wã. Tõnd me segd n teeg-⁠a lame.1 Rĩm dãmba 22:⁠41-⁠54; 2 Kibaya 20:​1-⁠30. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

BIIG sẽn ki sã n lebg n vʋʋge, a ma wã sũur pa na n yɩ noog sɩda? A sũurã na n yɩɩ noog hal wʋsgo! La ned sã n ki, a tõe n le vʋʋgame bɩ? Neb n zoe n ki n lebg n vʋʋg bɩ?

Ges-⁠y raoã ne pagã la bi-​riblã sẽn be foto wã zugã. Raoã yaa no-​rɛɛs a Eli. Pagã yaa pʋg-​kõor sẽn vɩ Zarefate, la bi-​riblã yaa pʋg-​kõorã biiga. Raar a yembre, biigã lʋɩɩ bãaga, la bãagã kengame hal tɩ biigã ki. A Eli yeela pagã t’a rɩk biigã n kõ-a.

A Eli reega biigã n dʋ yĩngr doog ningã yẽ sẽn da beẽ wã, n gãneg-⁠a gãagã zug n pʋʋs a Zeova n yeel yaa: ‘Zeova, kɩt tɩ biigã vʋʋge.’ Biigã sɩd vʋʋgame! A Eli talla biigã n sig n lebs-⁠a a ma la a yeel yaa: ‘Gese, fo biigã vʋʋgame.’ Yaa rẽ yĩng la yãmb sẽn ne tɩ pagã sũur yaa noog hal t’a nintãmã rʋʋgdẽ wã.

A Eliize me yɩɩ a Zeova no-​rɛɛsa. Sɩngrẽ wã a ra sõngda a Eli. La a Zeova wa n kɩtame tɩ yẽ me tõe n maand yel-​soalma. Daar a yembre, a Eliize kẽnga Sunem, tɩ pag reeg-⁠a sãand sõma. Pagã wa n doga bi-​ribla.

Biigã sẽn wa n lebg bedr bilfu, a yika raar a ye yibeoog n kẽng a ba wã nengẽ pʋtẽ wã. La biigã wa n yika zĩig pʋgẽ n kelemdẽ t’a zugã n zabde. B sẽn tall-⁠a n kulã, a tɩ kiime. A ma wã sũur sãama wʋsgo, t’a yik tao-​tao n tɩ bool a Eliize.

A Eliize sẽn ta wã, a kẽe roog ning pʋgẽ b sẽn gãneg biigã. A pʋʋsa a Zeova, la a tẽeg a meng biigã zugu. Sẽn yɩ bilfu, biigã tĩsa naoor a yopoe n puk a ninã. Pagã sẽn kẽ roogã pʋgẽ n yã t’a biigã vʋʋgame wã, a sũurã yɩɩ noog hal wʋsgo.

Neb nins sẽn ki wã yaa wʋsgo. B kũumã sãama b zaka rãmb ne b zo-​rãmbã sũy wʋsgo. Tõnd yẽ pa tõe n vʋʋg kũum ye. La a Zeova tõeeme. Taoore, d na n goma kũum vʋʋgrã yelle.1 Rĩm dãmba 17:​8-⁠24; 2 Rĩm dãmba 4:​8-⁠37. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

YÃMB mii bi-​puglã sẽn yet pagã bũmb ning bɩ? A gomda a Zeova no-​rɛɛs a Eliize yelle, la bũmb nins a Zeova sẽn kɩt t’a Eliize maanã me yelle. Pagã ka mi a Zeova ye, bala a pa Israɛll ned ye. Bɩ d ges sẽn sɩng to-⁠to tɩ bi-​puglã wa be pʋg-​kãngã zakẽ wã.

Pagã yaa Siiri tẽngã neda. A sɩdã yʋʋr la a Naama. Yaa Siiri sodaasã naaba. Siiri nebã yõka bi-​pugl kãngã sẽn yaa Israɛll nedã, n tɩ kɩt t’a lebg a Naama pagã tʋʋm-​biiga.

Wãood n tar a Naama. Yaa bãag sẽn sãamd ned yĩng hal t’a nusã ne a karsã tõe n kʋrse. Bi-​puglã yeela a Naama pagã yaa: ‘M zu-​soabã sã n da kẽngẽ a Zeova no-​rɛɛs ningã sẽn be Israɛllã nengẽ, a na n maaga a wãoodã.’ B togsa a Naama bi-​puglã sẽn yeel bũmb ningã.

A Naama ra rata ne a sũur fãa t’a wãoodã maage. A yikame n kẽng a Eliize nengẽ Israɛlle. A sẽn ta a Eliize zakẽ wã, a Eliize tʋma a tʋm-​tʋmdã t’a yi n yeel a Naama t’a kẽng Zʋrdẽ kʋɩlgẽ wã n tɩ lis koomẽ wã naoor a yopoe. La a Naama sũurã puugame t’a yeel tɩ yẽ tẽngã kʋɩls sãoo Israɛll kʋɩlsã fãa zĩig sẽn zãre. A lebgame t’a na n looge.

La a tʋm-​tʋmd a ye n yeel-⁠a yaa: ‘Naaba, a Eliize sã n da yeel yãmb tɩ y maan bũmb sẽn yɩɩd woto, y ra ka na n maan sɩda? Bõe yĩng tɩ y pa na n tɩ lis koomẽ wã wa a sẽn yeelã?’ A Naama kelga a tʋm-​tʋmdã goam n kẽng Zʋrdẽ kʋɩlgã pʋgẽ n tɩ lis naoor a yopoe, la a wãoodã maaga zãng fasɩ t’a yĩnga lebg sõma.

A Naama sũurã yɩɩ noog hal wʋsg t’a lebg n kẽng a Eliize nengẽ n tɩ yeel-⁠a yaa: ‘Masã, mam bãngame tɩ Wẽnnaam ka be zĩig a to ye. Yaa Israɛll bal la a be. Bɩ y reeg m kũunã masã.’ La a Eliize yeel-⁠a lame yaa: ‘Ayo, mam ka na n deeg bũmb ye.’ A Eliize ra miime tɩ pa sõma t’a reeg kũunã ye. Bala yaa a Zeova n da maag a Naama wãoodã, la pa yẽ ye. La a Eliize tʋm-​tʋmd a Gehazi yẽ da rata kũunã.

A Naama loogrã poore, a Gehazi wudgame n babs-⁠a n tɩ yeel-⁠a yaa: ‘A Eliize n tʋm maam tɩ m wa yeel-⁠y t’a kota kũunã bilf n kõ a zo-​rãmb sẽn wa mas-​masã n na n ges-⁠a.’ A Gehazi ra yagdame, la a Naama ra pa mi tɩ yaa ziri ye. A yãka teed kẽer n kõ a Gehazi.

A Gehazi sẽn lebg n kulã, a Eliize bãnga a sẽn maan bũmb ningã, bala a Zeova togs-⁠a lame. A Eliize yeela a Gehazi yaa: ‘Fo sẽn maan bũmb ningã yaa wẽnga. Rẽ n so t’a Naama wãoodã na n leb foo.’ La sɩd yɩɩ woto zĩig pʋgẽ bala.

Bõe la woto fãa zãmsd tõndo? Pipi, d segd n gomda a Zeova yell ne nebã wa bi-​puglã sẽn maanã, bala na n sõnga neb wʋsgo. Yiibu, d pa segd n zẽk d meng wa a Naama sẽn maan to-⁠to sɩngrẽ wã ye. D segd n kelga Wẽnnaam nebã saglsã. La tãabo, d pa segd n yag ziri wa a Gehazi ye.2 Rĩm dãmba 5:​1-⁠27. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

GES-⁠Y rao ning sẽn be koomã pʋgẽ wã. Yell n na n paam-⁠a, bala zĩnfã rat n vel-⁠a lame. Yãmb mii raoã bɩ? A yʋʋr la a Zonase. Bɩ d ges bũmb ning sẽn kɩt t’a wa be koomã pʋgẽ wã.

A Zonas yaa a Zeova no-​rɛɛsa. No-​rɛɛs a Eliize kũumã poor bala, a Zeova yeela a Zonas yaa: ‘Yik n kẽng Niniiv sẽn yaa tẽn-​kãsengã n tɩ moon n yeel t’a nebã kongame. Bala b wẽnemã yaa wʋsgo.’

La a Zonas ra pa rat n kẽng ye. A zãgsame n yik n kẽ batayo sẽn da pa teesd Niniiv sẽnes meng ye. La a Zeova sũurã pa yɩ noog ne-⁠a ye. A kɩtame tɩ seb-​kẽeng na n fug wʋsg hal tɩ batayo wã meng rat n bõre. Rabeem wʋsg n yõk batayo wã rãmb tɩ b kelemd n kot b wẽnnaam dãmbã tɩ b sõng-⁠ba. A Zonas wa n kong n yeel-⁠b lame yaa: ‘Mam tũuda a Zeova, Wẽnnaam ning sẽn naan yĩngr la tẽngã. A Zeova yeela maam tɩ m maan bũmbu, la mam pa rat n maan ye. Rẽ n kɩt tɩ m zoetẽ.’ Batayo wã rãmb sok-⁠a lame yaa: ‘D maan-⁠f bõe tɩ sebgã sigi?’

A Zonas yeelame tɩ b rɩk yẽ n lob koomã pʋgẽ tɩ koomã na n sigame. Batayo wã rãmb ra pa rat n lob-⁠a ye. La b sẽn wa n mik tɩ sebgã yãngdame wã, b kong n dɩk-⁠a lame n lob koomã pʋgẽ. Sebgã kell n yõka zĩig pʋgẽ, tɩ koomã me sigi.

B sẽn lob a Zonas koomẽ wã, zĩm-bedr n vel-⁠a, la a pa ki ye. A paa zĩnfã pʋgẽ rasem a tãabo. A Zonas sũurã sãamame, a sẽn zãgs a Zeova noorã n pa kẽng Niniivã. Yãmb mii a sẽn maan bũmb ning a sẽn wa n be zĩnfã pʋgẽ wã bɩ?

A pʋʋsa a Zeova n bõos-⁠a t’a sõng-⁠a. A Zeova kɩtame tɩ zĩnfã tɩ wʋk a Zonas koomã noore. Rẽ poore, a Zonas kẽnga Niniivi. Woto wilgda tõnd t’a Zeova sã n yeel tɩ d maan bũmbu, d segd n maaname.Zonas sak a 1 n tɩ tãag a 4. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

FOTO ning yãmb sẽn ne wã wilgda arzãnã sẽn na n yɩ to-⁠to. Na n yɩɩ wa no-​rɛɛs a Ezai sẽn da togsã. Yaa a Zonas kũumã poor bilf bal la a Ezai rog-​yã.

Arzãn yaa zĩig sẽn yaa neere, tɩ tɩɩs la rũms wʋsg be be. Yãmb sẽn get arzãnã sẽn be fotã zugã, tẽegda yãmb bõe? A pa wõnd zĩ-neer ning a Zeova sẽn da maneg n ning a Ãdem ne a Hawa wã sɩda? La rẽ yĩnga tẽngã fãa tõe n wa lebga arzãn bɩ?

A Zeova yeela no-​rɛɛs a Ezai t’a gʋls n wilg arzãnã sẽn na n yɩ to-⁠to. Ad a Ezai sẽn gʋls bũmb ninga: ‘We-​baas ne piis na n tũu taaba. La nag-⁠bi ne gɩgem-​poal na n naaga taab n wãb yamdo, tɩ bi-​bilf kɩɩm-⁠ba. Bi-​sigdg meng na n deema ruruug bok noor tɩ bũmb ka maan-⁠a ye.’

Neb kẽer na n tagsame tɩ woto pa tõe ye. Bala d rog n mikame tɩ zu-​loees beẽ, tɩ kɩt tɩ b tagsdẽ tɩ pa na n tol n sa ye. La yãmb sã n tags n gese, yɛ la Wẽnnaam da ning a Ãdem ne a Hawa?

Wẽnnaam da ning-⁠b-⁠la arzãn pʋgẽ. Yaa b sẽn kɩɩs Wẽnnaam noorã yĩng n kɩt tɩ b kong arzãnã, n kʋʋl la b ki wã. La Wẽnnaam pʋlmame t’a na n kɩtame tɩ neb nins sẽn nong yẽ wã paam bũmb nins a Ãdem ne a Hawa sẽn kongã.

Arzãnã pʋgẽ, wẽng pa na n zĩnd ye. Nebã fãa na n vɩɩmda ne laafɩ la sũ-noogo. Bãas pa na n le zĩnd ye. Nebã na n vɩɩmda wa Wẽnnaam sẽn da rat tɩ b vɩɩmd to-⁠to hal sɩngrẽ wã. D na n wa yãa Wẽnnaam sẽn na n wa maan rẽ fãa to-⁠to.Ezai 11:​6-⁠9; Wilgri 21:​3, 4. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

RAO ning sẽn pʋʋsd a Zeova tẽn-​kugrã taoorã yʋʋr la a Ezekɩase. Yaa Bẽnzame ne Zida buudã rĩma. Yãmb mii bũmb ning sẽn kɩt t’a pʋʋsd a Zeova wã bɩ? La bõe yĩng t’a rʋʋg seb-​kãensã a Zeova tẽn-​kugrã taoore? Yaa zu-​loees n tar-⁠a. La yaa bõe yĩnga?

Asiri sodaasã sãama Israɛll buud piigã. A Zeova basame tɩ b sãam-⁠ba, bala b ra tʋmda tʋʋm-​wẽnse. La masã, Asiri nebã waame n na n zab ne Bẽnzame la Zida buudã me.

Asiri rĩmã toola rĩm a Ezekɩas sɛb n na n paoog a Zeova la a yeel a Ezekɩas t’a ra nams a meng n zab ne yẽ ye. Yaa seb-​kãens la a Ezekɩas sẽn dʋʋg Wẽnnaam tẽn-​kugrã taoorã. La a Ezekɩas pʋʋsa a Zeova n yeel yaa: ‘Zeova, bɩ f fãag tõnd Asiri rĩmã nugẽ, tɩ dũniyã rãmb fãa bãng tɩ yaa foo bal n yaa Wẽnnaam.’ A Zeova kelga a Ezekɩas pʋʋsgã bɩ?

A Ezekɩas ra yaa rĩm-sõngo. A ra pa rĩm-​wẽng wa Israɛll buud piigã rĩm dãmba, bɩ wa a ba a Akaaz ye. A Ezekɩas ra modgdame n tũud a Zeova noyã fãa. Dẽnd a Ezekɩas sẽn pʋʋs n sa wã bala, no-​rɛɛs a Ezai tʋmame tɩ b tɩ yeel-⁠a t’a Zeova yeelame yaa: ‘Asiri rĩmã ka na n kẽ Zerizalɛm tẽngã pʋgẽ ye. A sodaag baa a ye meng ka na n kolg tẽngã ye. B ka na n tão peem baa a ye be ye.’

Ges-⁠y fotã sẽn be rɩtgã. Yaa yɛ sodaas la sẽn ki n dɩgã? Yaa Asiri sodaase. A Zeova tʋma a malɛk a ye t’a wa kʋ Asiri sodaas tus koabg la tus pis-​nii la a nu yʋn-​yɛng bala. Rẽ kɩtame tɩ Asiri rĩmã lebg n zoe n kul n pa yaas n zab yɛs ye. Dẽnd Bẽnzame ne Zida buudã põsame tɩ nebã tõog n le zĩnd ne laafɩ. La rĩm a Ezekɩas kũumã poore, yaa a biig a Manase n deeg naamã. A Manase ne a biig a Amo fãa yɩɩ rĩm-yoodo. Dẽnd nin-​kʋʋr la tʋʋm-​beed n le pid Bẽnzame ne Zida buudã neb sʋka. A Amo sõgen dãmbã wa n kʋ-⁠a lame, t’a biig a Zozɩas lebg Bẽnzame ne Zida buudã rĩma.2 Rĩm dãmba 18:​1-⁠36; 19:​1-⁠37; 21:​1-⁠25. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

A ZOZƖAS sẽn wa n na n sɩng naamã rɩɩb Zida ne Bẽnzame buudã zugã t’a ra tara yʋʋm a nii bala. Ad a ra paood ne naamã koe! Yaa rẽ yĩng la sẽn yɩ tɩlae tɩ kãsemb sõng-⁠a sɩngrẽ wã.

A Zozɩas sẽn deeg naamã tɩ yʋʋm a yopoe, a sɩngame n na n bao n bãng a Zeova sõma n paase. A rɩka rĩm a Davɩɩde, ne a Zozafat la a Ezekɩas mak-​sõngã. A Zozɩas sẽn da wa n ket n yaa biiga, a tʋma raood tʋʋma.

Maana yʋʋm wʋsg tɩ Israɛll neb wʋsg ra tʋmd tʋʋm-​wẽns hal tɩ looge. B ra pʋʋsda ziri wẽnnaam dãmba, la b wõgemded n pʋʋsd bõn-​naandse. Rẽ n so t’a Zozɩas ne a nebã yik n na n menes ziri tũudmã tẽngã pʋgẽ. Yɩɩ tʋʋm-​kãsenga, bala nebã wʋsg ra pʋʋsda ziri wẽnnaam dãmba. Yãmb pa ne a Zozɩas ne a nebã sẽn pãbd bõn-​naandsã n wãad sɩda?

Rẽ poore, a Zozɩas yãka rap a tãab tɩ b na n ges a Zeova roogã manegr yelle. Nebã loba ligd tɩ b kõ rapã tɩ b tall n tʋm tʋʋmdã. Wẽnd-​doogã manegr wakate, maan-​kʋʋdb kãsem a Hilkiya yãa sebr be n dɩke. Yaa sebr sẽn tar yõod wʋsgo. Yaa Tõog ning a Zeova sẽn da kɩt t’a Moiiz gʋls hal sẽn kaoosã. A ra menema hal yʋʋm wʋsgo.

B talla Tõogã n tɩ wilg a Zozɩase, t’a yeel tɩ b karem t’a kelge. B sẽn wa n karemdẽ wã, a Zozɩas yãame tɩ nin-​buiidã ra pa le tũud a Zeova noyã ye. Wa yãmb sẽn ne foto wã zugã, a sũurã sãama hal wʋsg t’a pãrg a fuugã. A yeelame yaa: ‘A Zeova sũur yika wʋsg ne tõndo, d yaab rãmbã sẽn pa sak seb-​kãngã goamã n maan wa b sẽn gʋlsã yĩnga.’ A Zozɩas yeela maan-​kʋʋdb kãsem a Hilkiya t’a bao n bãng a Zeova sẽn na n maan-⁠b bũmb ning masã. A Hilkiya kẽnga no-​rɛɛs-​poak a Hulda nengẽ n tɩ sok-⁠a. A Hulda yeelame tɩ b tɩ togs a Zozɩas t’a Zeova yeela woto: ‘Mam na n kɩtame tɩ toog paam Zerizalɛm ne a nebã. Bala bãmb pʋʋsa ziri wẽnnaam dãmba, la tẽngã me pida ne tʋʋm-​wẽnse. La foom a Zozɩas maana sẽn yaa sõma. Dẽnd yaa fo kũumã poor la m na n kɩt tɩ toogã paam nebã.’2 Kibaya 34:​1-⁠28. GES-⁠Y nebã sẽn yaand raoã. Yãmb mi-⁠a lame bɩ? A yʋʋr la a Zeremi. A yaa Wẽnnaam no-​rɛɛsa.

Rĩm a Zozɩas sẽn sɩng bõn-​naandsã sãoongã poor bilf bala, a Zeova yãka a Zeremi n kɩt t’a lebg a no-​rɛɛsa. A Zeremi ra tagsdame t’a paooda wʋsgo. La a Zeova yeelame t’a na n sõng-⁠a lame.

A Zeremi yeela Israɛll nebã tɩ b bas b tʋʋm-​wẽnsã. A yeel-⁠b lame tɩ tẽns a taabã nebã wẽnnaam dãmb yaa ziri wẽnnaam dãmba. Israɛll neb wʋsg ra basa Wẽnnaam a Zeova waoogre, n waoogd bõn-​naandse. A Zeremi sẽn yeel nebã tɩ Wẽnnaam na n sɩbg-⁠b-⁠la b tʋʋm-​wẽnsã yĩngã, b yaal-⁠a lame.

Yʋʋm wʋsg loogr poore, a Zozɩas kiime. La kiis a tãab poore, a biig a Zozakim n deeg naamã. A Zeremi ra ket n yeta nebã tɩ b sã n pa bas b tʋʋm-​wẽnsã, Zerizalɛm na n sãamame. La maan-​kʋʋdbã yõk-⁠a lame n yeel t’a sã n pa sĩnd fãa, b na n kʋ-⁠a lame. Maan-​kʋʋdbã yeela Israɛll nanambsã yaa: ‘A Zeremi segda ne kũum, bala a goma tõnd tẽngã wẽnga.’

Bõe la a Zeremi na n maan masã? A pa zoe rabeem ye. A yeela b fãa yaa: ‘Yaa a Zeova n tʋm maam tɩ m wa togs gom-​kãensã. Yãmb sã n ka bas y tʋʋm-​wẽnsã, a Zeova na n sãama Zerizalɛm. La bãng-⁠y tɩ yãmb sã n kʋ maam, yaa bʋʋm soab la y kʋ-​yã.’

Nanambsã pa kʋ a Zeremi ye, la Israɛll nebã pa bas b tʋʋm-​wẽnsã ye. Kaoosg zugẽ, Babilon rĩm a Nebukadnezaar wa n zaba ne Zerizalɛm n tõoge. A kɩtame tɩ Israɛll nebã lebg a yembse. A talla bãmb wʋsg n kẽng Babilon. Sã n da yaa yãmb la sãamb wa n yõk n tall n kẽng tẽng a to, y sũur pa na n sãam sɩda?Zeremi 1:​1-⁠8; 10:​1-⁠5; 26:​1-⁠16; 2 Rĩm dãmba 24:​1-⁠17. Sogsg zãmsgã yĩnga

RĨM a Nebukadnezaar wa n talla Israɛll neb nins fãa sẽn karem n zãagã n kẽng Babilon. Rẽ poore, a tũusa kom-​bɩɩs nins sẽn da be nin-​kãens sʋk n yaa rasãmb la b tar yamã. Kom-​dibli a naas nins yãmb sẽn ne fotã zugã bee b sẽn tũus-⁠b rãmbã sʋka. A ye yʋʋr la a Daniɛlle, la Babilon nebã pʋda a tãabã tɩ Sadrak, Mesak la Abɛdnego.
